en.name: Sukh-Bat.M
en.bio:
Sh.Sukhbat is a contemporary Mongolian artist. He graduated from the School of Fine Arts at the Mongolian University of Arts and Culture and earned his Master’s degree in 2014. Since 2017, he has been working as an independent artist.
His works explore the vast sense of the steppe, historical memory, and inner moments of emotion through a contemporary visual language. He has participated in many national and international exhibitions and held his solo exhibition “Moment” in 2019.
